note: The suite registry (Tom, 1 Nov 2026): every program, its contract-v2 feed, and the datasets it owns. Rule: each dataset is collected once, by the program that owns it; every other program reads the owner's feed (tips, python/tic_doctrine/tips.py) instead of collecting it again. Before adding a collector to a program, check `owns` here. COP's merged snapshot (`bus`) carries every live feed in one file, refreshed every two hours, with stale feeds flagged. fresh_hours and stale_hours match COP's settings. Planned programs list what they will own, so nobody builds it twice in the meantime.

bus.note: Items keep their own `program`; COP adds `cop_program` and `cop_stale` (true when that program's feed failed and its last good items were kept).

near-real-time data provided as is under the LANCE disclaimer (earthdata.nasa.gov/data/projects/lance/disclaimer); both read 13 Nov 2026; EIA-930: U.S. government publications are in the public domain and are not subject to copyright protection (eia.gov/about/copyrights_reuse.php, read 13 Nov 2026); acknowledged as Source: U.S. Energy Information Administration, with the date read; EAGLE-I outage history (base rates): CC BY 4.0 (creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0), as the figshare record states (doi:10.6084/m9.figshare.24237376, read 13 Nov 2026);
